license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice or offer to practice architecture in this state, or to use in connection with his or her name or otherwise assume, use, or advertise any title or description including the word "architect," "architecture," "architectural," or language tending to imply that he or she is an architect, unless the person is registered or authorized to practice in the state of Washington under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to pay, paying, or accepting substantial gifts, bribes, or consideration to influence the award of professional work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering to pay, paying, or accepting, either directly or indirectly, any substantial gift, bribe, or other consideration to influence the award of professional work

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being willfully untruthful or deceptive in any professional report, statement, or testimony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being willfully untruthful or deceptive in any professional report, statement, or testimony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having undisclosed financial interest in bidding or performance of a construction contract for which employed as architect, or allowing business interests to affect architectural decisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a financial interest in the bidding for or the performance of a contract to supply labor or materials for or to construct a project for which employed or retained as an architect except with the consent of the client or employer after disclosure of such facts; or allowing an interest in any business to affect a decision regarding architectural work

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing or permitting a seal to be affixed to drawings or specifications not prepared or reviewed by the architect or under the architect's supervision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing or permitting a seal to be affixed to any drawings or specifications that were not prepared or reviewed by the architect or under the architect's personal supervision by persons subject to the architect's direction and control

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully evading or trying to evade any law, ordinance, code, or regulation governing construction of buildings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully evading or trying to evade any law, ordinance, code, or regulation governing construction of buildings.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the person's profession or operation of the person's business, whether the act constitutes a crime or not.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining or renewing a license or in reinstatement thereof
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining or renewing a license or in reinstatement thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is false, deceptive, or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice that results in harm or damage to another or that creates an unreasonable risk of harm or damage to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of a license by competent authority in any other jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The suspension, revocation, or restriction of a license to engage in any business or profession by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with the disciplinary authority in the course of an investigation, audit, or inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with the disciplinary authority in the course of an investigation, audit, or inspection authorized by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplinary authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice or operate a business or profession when a license is required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice or operate a business or profession when a license is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the profession

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in unlicensed practice as defined in RCW 18.235.010.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Any business entity, including a sole proprietorship, offering architecture services in Washington state must register with the board, regardless of its business structure.

definition_quote.value: The rendering of any service or related work requiring architectural education, training, and experience, in connection with the art and science of building design for construction of any structure or grouping of structures and the use of space within and surrounding the structures or the design for construction of alterations or additions to the structures, including but not specifically limited to predesign services, schematic design, design development, preparation of construction contract documents, and administration of the construction contract.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of architecture" means the rendering of any service or related work requiring architectural education, training, and experience, in connection with the art and science of building design for construction of any structure or grouping of structures and the use of space within and surrounding the structures or the design for construction of alterations or additions to the structures, including but not specifically limited to predesign services, schematic design, design development, preparation of construction contract documents, and administration of the construction contract.

methods_authorized.quote: including but not specifically limited to predesign services, schematic design, design development, preparation of construction contract documents, and administration of the construction contract

interior_design_services_defined.quote: The practice of naval architecture, landscape architecture as authorized in chapter 18.96 RCW, engineering as authorized in chapter 18.43 RCW, or the provision of space planning or interior design services not affecting public health or safety

value: any other entity authorized to do business in the state
permitted_firm_structures.quote: "Person" means any individual, partnership, professional service corporation, corporation, joint stock association, joint venture, or any other entity authorized to do business in the state.

firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.value: The person having the practice of architecture in charge must be a general partner (if a partnership or LLP), manager (if LLC), or director (if corporation) and must be registered to practice architecture in this state.
firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.quote: the person having the practice of architecture in his/her charge is himself/herself a general partner (if a partnership or limited liability partnership), or a manager (if a limited liability company), or a director (if a business corporation or professional service corporation) and is registered to practice architecture in this state

seal_required.quote: Each registrant shall obtain a seal of the design authorized by the board bearing the architect's name, registration number, the legend "Registered Architect," and the name of this state. All technical submissions prepared by an architect and filed with public authorities must be sealed and signed by the architect.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: It is unlawful to seal and sign a document after a registrant's certificate of registration or authorization has expired, been revoked, or is suspended.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: Payment of a fine for each violation found by the disciplinary authority, not to exceed five thousand dollars per violation.
